originalTitle: The Mermaid Mask is a perfect vacation murder mystery

content: The Mermaid Mask, the next point-and-click game from Tangle Tower developer SFB Games, has everything you could ask for in a great murder mystery. It starts with a compelling setup: The captain of a submarine is found dead in a locked room, his body next to a mysterious cauldron with blood trickling across the floor. The colorful cast of suspects stationed aboard are delightful to talk to, including a grumpy author trying to draft a sequel to his hit novel, an actor playing the lead in a movie based on that novel, a young woman who puts on elaborate illusion performances, and even a man who studies dreams. The submarine works as an excellent setting that elevates the mystery — in a vehicle that already has such a small footprint, how does a locked-door crime happen in the first place? [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/ss_881d912fc1e4390a1072a21ac3202ca9a14a0882.1920x1080.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Like other crime-solving games, such as the Ace Attorney series, The Mermaid Mask is essentially a visual novel. As Detective Grimoire and his partner Sally, the returning protagonists from Tangle Tower, you’re primarily talking with suspects, investigating rooms, poring over objects, and solving puzzles. But each room is packed with nooks and crannies and knickknacks to click around on, investigate, and learn about, so there’s almost always something to dig into. The whole thing is backed by excellent voice acting; I often went out of my way to click on every detail I could find just to hear what the characters would say. The puzzles, which have you doing things like turning dials in exactly the right way or organizing skulls on a shelf, also do a good job breaking up what would otherwise be a whole lot of text conversations. Even though I haven’t played Tangle Tower, I didn’t feel like I was missing any meaningful context. The Mermaid Mask borrows a tried-and-true model from other franchises starring a returning detective, like with Knives Out’s Benoit Blanc: You can come into this story cold without missing anything important, but Detective Grimoire and Sally are a fun hang that make a few nods to their previous work together. [Image: Sometimes, you’ll have to puzzle together clues to form a conclusion. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/ss_e6a87f61718f2b1c8b8f473f8e7d9d3ce4982fee.1920x1080.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Eventually, after you gather enough evidence about somebody, you’ll confront them in Ace Attorney-like sequences where you’ll be able to make observations or accusations that the suspect rather wished you wouldn’t. These were extremely satisfying; it always felt good to figure out a tiny detail that would break someone’s facade wide open. Whenever the opportunity to do another one came up, I couldn’t wait to jump in. I had a few issues with The Mermaid Mask, but they’ll be familiar to anyone who likes playing these sorts of games. Presenting every clue to every suspect to get their reaction can be tedious. It’s not necessary, but I didn’t realize that until about halfway in my 10-hour playthrough when I spotted the hint system that suggests what you might want to show someone. Sometimes you have to make your case by presenting evidence in a specific order, even if you have already worked out where it might lead, so that the characters can talk things out as the script demands. At one point, I ran out of leads to explore and couldn’t figure where to go next until I manipulated one clue in one specific way that opened up a bunch of leads. More than once, I couldn’t figure out the exact clue that would advance things, so I just brute-forced guesses until I could move forward.  [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z9T_I7XTXDs] These roadblocks were frustrating. But that’s mostly because they stopped me from moving forward in a story that had me staying up way past my bedtime. When I reached the game’s finale — which begins with a classic murder mystery parlor room scene — I could hardly put my Steam Deck down because I wanted to see how all the pieces came together. When I finally finished The Mermaid Mask after a three-day tear, I felt like I had just closed the book on a satisfying murder mystery novel. The Mermaid Mask is out now on Nintendo Switch, PC, and PS5.
chineseTitle: 《美人鱼面具》是一部完美的假期谋杀之谜
chineseSummary: 《美人鱼面具》是 Tangle Tower 开发商 SFB Games 推出的下一款点击游戏，拥有您在大型谋杀悬疑游戏中所需要的一切。故事以一个引人入胜的场景开始：一艘潜艇的船长被发现死在一个上锁的房间里，他的尸体旁边有一个神秘的大锅，地板上淌着血。 […]
chineseContent: 《美人鱼面具》是 Tangle Tower 开发商 SFB Games 推出的下一款点击游戏，拥有您在大型谋杀悬疑游戏中所需要的一切。故事以一个引人入胜的场景开始：一艘潜艇的船长被发现死在一个上锁的房间里，他的尸体旁边有一个神秘的大锅，地板上淌着血。驻扎在船上的犯罪嫌疑人阵容各异，交谈起来很愉快，其中包括一位脾气暴躁的作家试图为他的热门小说起草续集，一位在根据该小说改编的电影中扮演主角的演员，一位进行精心制作的幻觉表演的年轻女子，甚至还有一位研究梦的男人。潜艇作为一个绝佳的场景，提升了神秘感——在一辆占地面积如此小的车辆中，锁门犯罪最初是如何发生的？ [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/ss_881d912fc1e4390a1072a21ac3202ca9a14a0882.1920x1080.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 与其他破案游戏一样，例如逆转裁判系列， 《美人鱼面具》本质上是一部视觉小说。作为侦探格里莫尔和他的搭档莎莉，从《缠结塔》中回归的主角，你的主要任务是与嫌疑人交谈、调查房间、仔细研究物体和解决谜题。但每个房间都充满了角落、缝隙和小摆设，可以点击、调查和了解，所以几乎总有一些东西可以挖掘。整件事都有出色的配音支持；我经常不遗余力地点击我能找到的每一个细节，只是为了听听角色会说什么。这些谜题让你做一些事情，比如以正确的方式转动表盘或整理架子上的头骨，也能很好地打破原本会是大量的文字对话。虽然
